notes.title: Game Update Version: 0.9.1.1010
notes.notes:
Hello, good morning, afternoon, and evening to all the workers. I’m not sure how everyone is doing in "冥途幸存" (Survival in the Underworld), but we continue to bring updates for the game.

Version: 0.9.1.1010

Added OP (you can take a look)
New item: Clear-screen item dropped from the shrine
Fixed a bug where selecting cards instantly after locking could cause skill cards to get stuck
Fixed a UI bug where the screen would get stuck on the delivery interface
Added 3 achievements for completing training mode, with gold rewards
Odd/even numbers now have a red circle highlight
Added some hints to the FuluShou delivery levels
Continued to reduce the difficulty of unlocking some achievements
Fixed several exceptions that caused crashes
Fixed a bug where disconnecting briefly would deduct 800 points
Fixed a bug where server abnormalities led to crashes
We are still working on updating and optimizing the game. Thanks for everyone’s support, and as the Spring Festival is approaching, I wish everyone a Happy New Year in advance!

— From the studio that is equally exhausted but still working hard for the game

notes.title: Version 0.9.1008 Update
notes.notes:
* Added invincibility blinking effect after a character is attacted.
* Fix the bug that Ksitigarbha consuming EXP caused experience model not to be destroyed.
* Update server linking process.
* Fix the bug of false disconnection
* Fix the problem of closing the BGM of Fiery Bunny.
* Fix the bug that the mouse can't be clicked by pressing ESC in Delivery Stage.
* Fix the bug of the probability of Icy Path 
* Fix the problem that Megalophobia doesn't take effect
* Fix some problems that will lead to flashback

notes.title: Version 0.9.1004 Update
notes.notes:
In version 0.9.1004, the Copper Bonus has been greatly adjusted:

* Achievements can be unlocked in room mode
* Increased the copper bonus of some matches

Thank you all for your favor and help! We’ll update a version later today to fix matters about volume, currency and so on.
